description: Who watched specific videos (or any video of a folder) in a period: distinct viewers, identified by IP. The IP is returned MASKED (a.b.x.x) — the full list is in the dashboard (Analytics → Users). The selection only chooses WHICH viewers appear: each viewer's metrics (play, view, watch_time) cover the whole account, not only these videos. Returns {scope, start_date, end_date, total_viewers, viewers: [{viewer_ip, play, view, unique_play, unique_view, watch_time_seconds, videos_watched}] (most plays first), warnings}.

folder_id.description: Folder ID: uses every video in the folder (up to 5000). Use this OR video_external_ids.

limit.description: How many viewers to list (default 50, max 500); total_viewers counts all

start_date.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: 30 days ago — always sent, since the API returns partial data without it.

video_external_ids.description: video_external_id of each video (field `video_external_id` from panda_list_videos / panda_get_video — NOT the `id`). Max 2000. Use this OR folder_id.

name: panda_get_viewers_by_videos
title: Get Viewers by Videos
